verdict.rationale: GrowthBook ships 24 official SDKs spanning web (React, script tag, edge Cloudflare Workers), backend (Python, plus server-side inline experiments), and mobile (Kotlin for Android, Swift for iOS and other Apple platforms). Consistency comes from a single cacheable JSON feature definition, served via the SDK Connection Endpoint and evaluated locally in each SDK. The 2021 founder comment that native mobile SDKs did not exist yet is superseded by the current Kotlin and Swift docs. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of cross-SDK evaluation parity (e.g., shared test suites or hashing guarantees), dedicated backend SDK docs in the pack beyond the README mention, and independent hands-on corroboration of consistent behavior across platforms.
